response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS bats, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT bats, award_count, CAST(award_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(award_count) FROM c) AS share FROM c), t AS (SELECT bats, award_count, share, (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT bats, award_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM t WHERE share > avg_share
